title: I bought two and both broke
text:
I bought two and both broke. Wasted a lot of money.

Looks nice in bathroom and love the design. However, it’s so flimsy and easy to break. There’s a little plastic piece that keeps the lid locked - that’s what keeps breaking and now the lid is wide open where i can see yucky trash.
Bought TWO that broke…. I highly suggest not buying this.
